entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:1
segments: Ministers of God delight in proclaiming the blessings which will come on his people; and though in faithfulness they must point out the destruction that will come on the wicked, they do it with earnest desires that they may turn from their wicked ways and live.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:2
segments:
Came from Sinai--Seir--Paran; these mountains in and around the Arabian desert are here taken collectively, as the place whence God manifested himself in a special manner, first to Moses, and afterwards to the whole people. 
 
  Saints; his ministering angels are meant.
We may render more literally, He came from the myriads of his holy ones; that is, from his secret dwelling-place, where he is surrounded by myriads of angels.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:3
segments: All his saints; all the holy ones of Israel his people.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:4
segments: Even the inheritance; the law is itself the inheritance of God's covenant people.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:6
segments: Reuben; his posterity; the tribe of Reuben, which had an ample and fertile territory on the east of the Jordan.  Simeon is passed over in silence.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:7
segments:
Bring him unto his people; bring him home safe from his conflicts with his enemies. 
 
  Be sufficient for him; or, as some render, strive for him; that is, let his hands, strengthened by thee, fight his battles successfully. 
 
Those who have God for their helper will at last triumph over all their foes.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:8
segments:
With thy holy one; the high-priest is meant, who bore the Urim and Thummim, and was of the tribe of Levi. 
 
  Massah--Meribah;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:9
segments: Not seen--acknowledge--nor knew his own children; he did not spare his own relatives, or favor any who were guilty, but executed divine justice upon them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:12
segments:
By him; the Lord.  Jerusalem was in the tribe of Benjamin. 
 
  Between his shoulders; as a father bears a child upon his shoulders.  God would be near him and protect him. 
 
It is a great blessing to enjoy religious privileges, and dwell near the house of the Lord; and those who delight in worshipping him on earth are preparing for the worship of heaven.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:13
segments: The deep that coucheth beneath; the subterranean waters, which break forth in springs.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:14
segments: By the sun, and--the moon; their influence in ripening the products of the earth.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:16
segments: Him that dwelt in the bush;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:17
segments: Horns of unicorns; see note on

. 
 
  Ephraim, and--Manasseh; the two tribes which descended from Joseph. Thus he foretells to Ephraim a more numerous posterity than to Manasseh.
The fidelity of parents is often followed by rich and lasting blessings on their children.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:18
segments: In thy going out; for traffic.

Zebulun would be a commercial and enterprising tribe. 
 
  In thy tents; abiding in quietness at home.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:19
segments:
Treasures hid in the sand; or, hid treasures of the sand.  The sand here represents the seashore, and then, generally, the wealth that comes to it through commerce. 
 
Sacrifices of righteousness offered in love to God, will be rewarded with all needed abundance on earth, and with endless and inexhaustible treasures in heaven.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:21
segments:
The first part for himself; in the country which the Israelites first conquered, on the east of Jordan. 
 
  A portion of the lawgiver; that which Moses, their lawgiver, assigned to them. 
 
  He came with the heads of the people; went over Jordan with the rest of the Israelites and assisted them in the conquest of Canaan. 
 
In executing just punishments on the wicked, when called to it by God, men may be acceptably serving him and securing his blessings.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:22
segments: Leap from Bashan; Bashan was a country east of Jordan, between the mountains of Hermon and Gilead. From this country the Danites made successful warlike excursions.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:23
segments:
West and--south; west and south of that which was conquered by the Danites. 
 
For all temporal as well as spiritual favors, men are dependent on the blessing of the Lord.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:25
segments:
Thy shoes; or, thy bars. 
 
  Iron and brass; invincible to the power of the enemy. 
 
  As thy days, so shall thy strength be; thy strength shall endure as long as thy days.  Some render, As thy days, so shall thy quietness be. 
 
The Lord communicates to those who trust in him, all which they need to secure in the end their highest good.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:27
segments:
The enemy; the Canaanites. 
 
To have God for our refuge is the best security from fear, and the safest protection from danger.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:28
segments: Alone; not incorporated with other nations.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 33:29
segments: Be found liars unto thee; rather, shall crouch to thee from fear; shall be forced to submit themselves to thee.
